zh.title: 官网首页围绕 AI for Science 重构
zh.summary: PhAI Labs 官网首页重新组织：围绕 AI for Science 的模型与数据基础设施，说明为什么科学智能是第三条 Scaling Law，以及数据与实验如何在同一个闭环里训练模型。
body: 2026 年 8 月，PhAI Labs 官网首页完成重构，围绕 AI for Science 的模型与数据基础设施重新组织内容。
首页提出的判断是：科学智能是第三条 Scaling Law。公开数据已经见底，前沿模型真正短缺的输入，是带有真实结果的科学数据。它无法被抓取，只能被生产出来。
首页用一个闭环来说明这件事：数据训练模型，模型设计下一个实验。模型的失败就是值得检验的假设；实验返回的每一个结果，包括失败，都变成奖励、更难的评测和下一轮的任务。
这次重构是官网的第二个版本，也是后续技术发布的承接页面。

en.title: Homepage rebuilt around AI for Science
en.summary: The PhAI Labs homepage was reorganized around model and data infrastructure for AI for Science: why scientific intelligence is the third scaling law, and how data and experiments train the model in one loop.
body: In August 2026, the PhAI Labs homepage was rebuilt around model and data infrastructure for AI for Science.

The claim it makes is that the third scaling law is scientific intelligence. Intelligence has run out of internet; the one input the frontier is short of is scientific data with a verified physical outcome attached. It cannot be scraped. It has to be produced.

The homepage describes this as a loop: data trains the model, and the model designs the next experiment. A model’s failures are the hypotheses worth testing; what comes back from the bench, including every failure, returns as reward, as a harder benchmark and as the next task.
This rebuild is the second version of the site, and the base on which the coming technical releases will land.
